headline: Ownership Battles Shift Across Six Active Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the contest shifting rather than settling, with Stlican Shelf now the sharpest new flashpoint. Its daily strategic-base events have climbed from 24 to 32, including eight in the latest two hours and eleven in six; six Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base are presently recorded. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest theatre, though its tally has eased from 64 to 62 daily events, with one in the latest two hours; the line stands five Warden to four Colonial, and both casualty streams remain heavy. Fisherman’s Row has risen from 33 to 36 daily events and registered three in the latest two hours, holding six Colonial and three Warden bases. Mooring County has advanced from twelve to fourteen events, with two in six hours, while its eleven Warden and one Colonial bases remain unevenly held. Callahan’s Passage is active at thirty daily events but quiet in the latest two hours, all ten bases Warden-held. Nevish Line has ten daily events, three in the latest two hours, and retains seven Warden bases against one neutral holding. Other sectors show little recent ownership movement.
